title: Commercial Pilot
description:
Join our airline as a Commercial Pilot. Key Responsibilities:
- Safely operate commercial aircraft on scheduled domestic and international flights.
- Conduct pre-flight inspections and review weather conditions and flight plans.
- Ensure compliance with all FAA regulations and company safety protocols.
- Communicate effectively with air traffic control and crew members.
Requirements:
- Valid Airline Transport Pilot (ATP) Certificate.
- Current First-Class Medical Certificate.
- Minimum of 1,500 flight hours, with experience in multi-engine jet aircraft.
- Exceptional decision-making skills and calm under pressure.
